Interface J3ErrSeverity

All Known Subinterfaces:
J3DFatal, J3DInfo, J3DMild, J3DWarning
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultObjectDeletionException, DocsGenException, GenericException, GenericIOException, ImgGenException, InteractionException, InvalidCopyException, J3DFileException, JaivaRunException, LongTaskException, MatrixException, PrefsGenException, ProjectFileException
public sealed interface J3ErrSeverity permits J3DFatal, J3DMild, J3DWarning, J3DInfo
Defines the contract for error severity levels within J3Engine

Implementors are different error severities, and all J3DError are expected to implement one of these interfaces.
